findings.text: s25's Why says "The pane judged the snapshot's age, while the hook judged the station's own heartbeat and tick", but the pane already reads the station's own beat and tick, reads a slow tick as slow, and only reaches the snapshot-age sentence when `read_station_tick()` answers nothing (absent, unreadable or beatless store — `read_station_tick` returns None on each of those, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:519-552) or when the station store is not the source — a worker sent to make the pane "read the station as alive but slow" finds that already implemented and has no stated endpoint for the fallback that produced the reported line
